spans.s:
मृण् r. 6th cl. (मृणति)
 1. To hurt, to injure.
 2. To kill.

मृणाल mn. (-लः-लं) The film or fibres attached to the stalk of a lotus.
n. (-लं) The root of a fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum.)
“वीरणमूले”.
 f. (-ली) A small fibre in the stalk of the water-lily. E.
मृण् to hurt, Unādi aff. कालन् ।

मृणालिन् m. (-ली) A lotus.
 f. (-लिनी)
 1. An assemblage of lotus flowers.
2. A place abounding with lotuses.
 3. A lotus plant.
 E. मृणाल a
fibre, इनि aff.

मृण्मय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of earth or clay, (as porcelain, &c.)
 E. मृत, मयट् aff.; also मृन्मय ।
